ov: عيون مغلقة على اتساعها (الإنجليزية: Eyes Wide Shut) فيلم أميركي أنتج عام 1999 وهو من إخراج ستانلي كوبريك الذي توفي قبل عرضه، ومن بطولة الممثل توم كروز وزوجته آنذاك نيكول كيدمان. قصة الفيلم مقتبسة عن قصة قصيرة للكاتب النمساوي آرثر شنيتزلر. استغرق تصوير الفيلم 400 يوم وتم إدراجه في موسوعة غينيس للأرقام القياسية.
plotEn:
Dr. Bill Harford and his wife Alice live in New York City with their daughter Helena. At a Christmas party hosted by a patient, Victor Ziegler, Bill reunites with his medical school classmate Nick Nightingale, who now plays piano professionally. Party guests attempt to seduce Alice and Bill. Ziegler interrupts Bill with news of an overdose by Mandy, a woman he was having sex with. Bill helps Mandy recover.
The next night, while smoking marijuana, Alice and Bill discuss their unfulfilled temptations. Bill is not jealous of other men's attraction to Alice, believing women to be naturally faithful. Alice admits to fantasizing about a naval officer she met on vacation and considering leaving Bill and Helena. Bill is disturbed before being called to a patient's house. The patient's daughter, Marion, tries to seduce Bill.
After leaving Marion's, Bill meets a prostitute named Domino. When Alice calls, Bill backs out but pays Domino after kissing her. He then meets Nick at a jazz club. Nick describes a masked orgy in a mansion outside New York City, at which he will play piano blindfolded, and gives Bill the password to enter the party. Bill goes to a costume store to buy an outfit for the orgy and offers the owner, Milich, money to rent a costume. He and Milich find Milich's teenage daughter engaged in sexual activity with two men. Milich locks the men in a room and threatens to call the police.
Bill goes to the mansion and gives the password, discovering a sexual ritual in progress
